hook: White grabbed the free pawn on e5. Seven moves later, checkmate (Oct 21)
text: White grabbed the free pawn on e5. Seven moves later, checkmate (Oct 21) Greedy play in the opening gets punished fast in speed chess. When Black plays 3...Nd4, White thinks: 'A free pawn with an f7 attack!' Then came 4.Nxe5? Qg5! and White's king never survived past move 7. The refutation: 4.Nxd4! exd4 5.O-O, leaving White with superior development and complete center control.
